### The Day I Rolled Down the Window - Crosswalk the Devotional - May 3
Author: John UpChurch
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-may-2-2013.html
Passage: 1 John 4:18
Points:
- Unplanned encounters often challenge our reluctance to step into messy situations.
- We tend to pull back from people who do not match our personal preferences.
- God demonstrated His love by embracing us despite our spiritual brokenness.
- Following Jesus means overcoming awkwardness and fear to share love across social divides.

### Ruth Bell Graham: A Legacy of Love
Author: Jim Burns
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-june-22-2007-11545108.html
Passage: 1 John 4:18
Points:
- Genuine love dispels anxiety because God is already present in our future.
- A home anchored in authentic love equips families to endure severe trials.
- Responding to hardship with prayer and love replaces dread with quiet confidence.
- Resting securely in Christ's love frees believers from fear even in the face of death.
